params.command: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $temp=Join-Path $env:TEMP 'mhw-hcp-pr144-diffcheck'; if(Test-Path $temp){Remove-Item -Recurse -Force $temp}; git clone --branch agent/hcp-converge-0.2.0-20260929 --single-branch https://github.com/fengie/mhw-mods.git $temp; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){exit $LASTEXITCODE}; git -C $temp fetch origin main:refs/remotes/origin/main; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){exit $LASTEXITCODE}; $sha=(git -C $temp rev-parse HEAD).Trim(); Write-Output ('HEAD_SHA='+$sha); git -C $temp diff --check origin/main...HEAD; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){exit $LASTEXITCODE}; Write-Output 'PR144_DIFFCHECK_PASS'; Remove-Item -Recurse -Force $temp -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
